operations.name: Search Sounds
operations.description: Find sounds in the user's local audio Libraries from a free-text description in any language (or sounds similar to a known asset). Omit libraryId to search every Library at once. Each result gives the absolute path of the original file, duration, tags, categories, a 0-100 score per model and, for long recordings, the matching time segment: enough to propose sounds to the user. Each model retrieves from its own index; ranks are fused with weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion. The job is asynchronous: poll cy_get_job and read outputs.results when Completed.

libraryId.description: Optional. Absent = search all Libraries (results carry libraryId and libraryName). Required with similarTo.

text.description: Free text in any language, e.g. "gros impact métallique très lourd avec une longue réverbération"

operations.name: Write Metadata Into Files
operations.description: CHANGES ORIGINAL FILES. Writes description, tags, categories, rating and AudioId into the files themselves (ID3 for WAV/AIFF/MP3, Vorbis comments for FLAC/OGG/Opus, MP4 atoms for M4A). Tags are written into a copy, the decoded audio is verified identical, then the copy replaces the original; a backup goes to the Library cache by default. Embeddings stay valid.
